fixed_copy.section_heading: What Your Responses Show So Far
fixed_copy.transition: This is a measured preview rather than a complete interpretation. The wider profile depends on behaviours, relationships and human capabilities that have not yet been shown.

opening_modules.text: Across your responses, AI was involved most clearly while ideas were still being developed and organised, rather than only after your thinking was complete.
Across several assessed behaviours, you reported substantial AI involvement in work or thinking while continuing to retain direction over what was accepted and carried forward.
Your responses most clearly show AI being used to organise difficult questions and reduce uncertainty, while responsibility for the eventual conclusion remained more personally directed.
The measured pattern shows stronger AI involvement in practical tasks and problem-solving than in personal or emotionally focused interaction.
Across the assessed behaviours, you reported using AI as a relatively private setting for expressing or organising thoughts, experiences or feelings.
Your responses show a measurable difference between private engagement with AI and how openly that engagement is made visible to other people.
The assessed pattern indicates that AI may be affecting not only the answers you reach, but also how you evaluate your own judgement and identify the origins of ideas.
In some assessed situations, your responses indicate that AI moved beyond offering input and became more involved in which conclusion or action was carried forward.
Your responses indicate that AI is established enough in some routines for its availability to affect momentum, confidence or the ease of beginning certain tasks.
No single measured behaviour dominated your results. Instead, the role of AI varied more by situation than by one consistent pattern.

qualifier_modules.text: Several separate responses supported the same direction, making this a recurring measured pattern rather than the result of one isolated answer.
A related part of the assessed profile moved differently, indicating that the pattern is conditional and cannot be summarised accurately by one behaviour alone.
One measured behaviour counterbalanced another, allowing substantial AI involvement to coexist with a retained human boundary.
The assessed pattern contains a tension between greater AI influence and the parts of the process that remained more personally owned.
The pattern changed across contexts, with AI appearing more influential in some situations and more limited or easier to set aside in others.
The strongest measured signals were concentrated within one area of behaviour, while the remainder of the profile was more even.
The measured signals were distributed across several areas, indicating broad AI involvement rather than one narrow or isolated use.
Your direct self-estimate did not fully align with the pattern formed by the other assessed responses, creating a measurable perception gap.
No single result was sufficiently distinctive to define the overall pattern, so balance and variation provide the most defensible summary.

takeaway_modules.text: The measured pattern shows greater AI involvement in developing thoughts than in determining final judgements.
The assessed behaviours show substantial AI integration alongside retained personal direction.
AI involvement was most evident when difficult thinking needed structure or clarification.
AI use was more prominent in practical activity than across every area of personal life.
The assessed pattern shows a private reflective role for AI that may not be equally visible socially.
AI involvement extended into how judgement and idea ownership were evaluated.
In selected responses, AI influenced not only the available options but the action ultimately taken.
The measured pattern indicates that AI’s absence can alter how some tasks or decisions are experienced.
Context, rather than one dominant behaviour, provides the clearest summary of the measured pattern.

curiosity_bridges.text: This summary is limited to the behaviours already revealed. Six dimensions and their interactions remain outside the free snapshot.
The assessment has not yet shown where AI may be extending capability, where human skills remain actively exercised or how the remaining behaviours alter this pattern.
What remains unresolved is how the unrevealed parts of the profile qualify, reinforce or change the meaning of these measured results.
The available results establish a broad direction, but they do not provide the complete interpretation of how the measured behaviours work together.

measurement_standard.principle: Describe what the participant reported and what the assessment measured, not what the participant fundamentally is.
restricted_phrasing: the kind of person you are
